summary_en: 700,000 shares (3.41% of S/O), ¥2.0B upper limit. Execution window 18 Aug – 30 Dec 2026. Open-market method on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Rationale: capital efficiency (ROE improvement), flexible capital policy, shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Nippon Ceramic's board has authorized the acquisition of up to 700,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 3.41% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥2.0 billion. The program runs from 18 August 2026 through 30 December 2026 and will be executed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company states the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency metrics (such as ROE), enable flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions, and enhance returns to shareholders. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 6,718,049 treasury shares against 20,513,208 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
